current_data.price_data: DS-EXP-050 (50 instruments, ~2000 trading days), DS-EXP-100 (100 instruments, ~2000 trading days)
current_data.feature_to_sample_ratio: 5-15 features / ~2000 observations = FAVORABLE for linear models, MARGINAL for tree models

Linear_models.rationale: 5-15 features with ~2000 observations provides adequate sample for Ridge/Lasso/ElasticNet

Tree_models.rationale: Phase 22-R validated infrastructure. ~2000 observations sufficient for shallow trees with regularization

Regime_conditioned_linear.rationale: Regime split divides data ~50/50, still ~1000 observations per regime — sufficient

Hidden_Markov_Model.rationale: ~2000 daily observations may be sufficient for simple HMM with 2-3 states, but convergence is not guaranteed

Mixture_of_experts.rationale: Gating network requires sufficient data per expert — marginal with regime splits

LSTM.rationale: ~2000 time periods insufficient for meaningful sequence learning. Need 10K+ periods.

TCN.rationale: Same as LSTM — insufficient temporal depth

compute_assessment.current_infrastructure: Python + polars + numpy + scipy + sklearn — SUFFICIENT for all justified model classes
compute_assessment.additional_compute_needed: None for justified models. GPU required for deep learning (NOT justified).
